rows.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 15.2.0, 64-bit

queries.name: vehicle_relations
queries.query: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,a.attname FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE a.attname IN ('vehicle_id','reserved_vehicle_id') AND NOT a.attisdropped AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: name_collision
queries.query: SELECT n.nspname,p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,p.proowner::regrole::text AS owner FROM pg_namespace n LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.pronamespace=n.oid WHERE n.nspname='fleet_private' OR (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('register_my_vehicle','list_my_vehicles','update_my_vehicle','set_my_vehicle_availability','deactivate_my_vehicle')) ORDER BY 1,2
